name: disc-drop-a
prompt: A light wooden game disc falls down a vertical plastic slot and lands with a single soft clack.

name: disc-drop-b
prompt: A checker piece drops into a connect-four style board and settles with a short hollow plastic knock.

name: disc-drop-c
prompt: A small resin disc slides down a chute and taps the stack of discs below with a muted woody tick.

name: line-win
prompt: A bright ascending chime of four struck metal bars, a celebratory game win jingle with a short shimmering tail.

name: board-draw
prompt: Two soft wooden blocks knocked together twice, a neutral even-match draw signal, dry and short.

name: move-limit-bell
prompt: A small brass desk bell rung once, then a lower wooden tok, signaling a move budget has run out.

name: resign-fold
prompt: A soft cloth game mat being folded with a low flap and a single descending muted piano note.

name: time-up-tick
prompt: A mechanical timer ticking twice quickly, then a small spring buzz as the clock runs out.

name: column-full-thud
prompt: A game disc bumped against the top of an already full column, a dull rubbery thud for a rejected move.

name: bad-column-knock
prompt: A single short hollow knock on the plastic edge of a game board, indicating an invalid column choice.

name: banned-column-rattle
prompt: A quick rattle of a small plastic gate being blocked, three rapid clicks for a forbidden column.

name: out-of-turn-tap
prompt: Two light fingertip taps on a wooden table, a gentle not-your-turn warning.

name: game-ended-dull
prompt: A soft muted drum thump with a short low decay, signaling the game has already ended.

name: unknown-command-buzz
prompt: A short low electric buzz like a quiz-show wrong-answer buzzer, half a second long.

name: malformed-command-click
prompt: A single dry mechanical switch click followed by a faint plastic snap, a rejected input.
